newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Edgars shares cut after poor year results.
newsitem.headline: Edgars shares cut after poor year results.

text.p: Clothing retailer Edgars Ltd shares fell on Tuesday after it reported year results below analysts expectations, dealers said.
"Their results were not well received. I see (the shares) softening to about 112.50 to 112.75 rand," one dealer said.
Edgar shares, after trading 75 cents weaker before the results release at 1230 GMT, dropped another rand to 113 rand after the news. Overall volumes traded were worth almost 4.62 million rand.

Edgars earlier reported attributable earnings for the year to end-March down five percent at 320.9 million rand, which translated into earnings per share of 598.0 cents. Analysts polled by Reuters had expected earnings at a consensus 638 cents per share.
It declared a flat total dividend of 247 cents.
Edgars said business in the first six months of its new financial year would remain tight amid expected continued subdued economic activity.
